findings.title: render() silently drops a caller-supplied value for a slot declared in ai_slots on a 'both' template.
findings.evidence: tools/template_library.py render(), diff lines ~1186-1199; not exercised by test_both_fills_the_deterministic_slots_and_briefs_the_rest.
findings.consequence: A caller's value vanishes with no error.
findings.minimal_fix: Raise LibraryError if any key in values is in ai_slots.
